title: Beta 0.4: The Big Glow-Up
notes: The Hub is now a walkable Hub Town with day and night, a minimap and a living crowd. Settings > Hub style brings back the Arena Lobby.
Six shop kinds (Mart, Boutique, Bazaar, Depot, PokeNet, Night Market), each with its own stock and perk.
Run events in 12 story styles, 60 set-piece events, 72 NPC events and 122 live calendar events.
12 anime Trade Stop looks, four Trainer Plaza looks and ten battle styles.
Pokemon Memories cutscenes: Z-Moves, Tera, Dynamax, Mega Evolution, animated bosses and VS screens.
New looks for nearly every screen: title, map, rewards, party, bag, Pokedex, settings and more.
Care and bonds, Nuzlocke modes, Weekly Gauntlet, camp crafting and Nemesis rival upgrades.

title: Tools and community
notes: New Tools room in the Hub: what's new, content status, your stats, the seed board, mod packs and a bug report.
Performance preset (Low, Medium, High) in Settings.
Install the game as an app; it keeps working offline once loaded.
A notice appears when a newer version of the game is online.
Runs that used the debug tools are marked as assisted.

title: Majors and legacy
notes: Nemesis system, bank tiers, Totems with doubles, levels past 100.
Music and sound from the packs; the animation registry covers rivals and Hyper moments.
